title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;  JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:

About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives. You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil What you'll need 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. - Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. - Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Technical Assistant
description:

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date.   Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements.   Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person.   Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance.   Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites.   Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation.   Providing technical support to the sales department as needed.   Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.     What You’ll Bring    Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage.   Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic.   Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.   Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).   Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar em Campinas e Região. description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista de Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade também para PCD♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:    The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:     Quarterly package review    - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses    - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items    - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:    The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:    Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:     Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:

Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class technical customer service to our clients.    This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving complex customer challenges.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Supporting all post-sales activities.   Successfully and timely booking and lifecycle handling of all quotations.   Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.   Providing customers with technical support, general product and service information.   Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.   Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.   Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.   Handling purchasing orders, logistics and inventory.   Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.   Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system.   You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.     What You’ll Bring    Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.   Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.   Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.    Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at  .

title: Gestor de Negócios II | Diagnóstico IVD
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Gestor de Negócios II | Diagnóstico IVD em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

VIVEO - Cuidar de cada vida, simples assim!   Fundados em 1996, somos líderes na fabricação e na distribuição de materiais e medicamentos para o segmento da saúde, com produtos e soluções para todo o Brasil. Com capital 100% nacional, com mais de 50 unidades operacionais e centros de distribuição em todas as regiões do país, temos nossa própria frota e contamos com mais de 6.500 colaboradores diretos.    Com o propósito de cuidar de cada vida, somos a única empresa do Brasil que atua de forma completa no mercado da saúde. Essa atuação reforça nosso compromisso em oferecer soluções confiáveis, ágeis e inovadoras ao setor – incluindo fabricação, distribuição, gestão de estoque, transporte e soluções personalizadas aos hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, farmácias, atacados, indústrias farmacêuticas e aos pacientes finais. Buscamos encontrar e viabilizar as inovações que definirão como cuidar das pessoas do amanhã.    Atividades:   Buscamos um profissional com perfil estratégico e comercial para atuar na gestão e desenvolvimento de uma carteira regional de laboratórios clínicos, com foco no mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD). Será responsável por fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, identificar oportunidades de expansão, analisar mercado e concorrência, conduzir negociações e ampliar a participação da empresa nas contas existentes. A atuação será na região de Campinas e arredores, com rotina externa, visitas a clientes e interface com áreas internas para garantir execução, crescimento e geração de valor ao negócio.    Responsabilidades e atribuições:   • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, com atuação próxima aos clientes da carteira regional, buscando relacionamento de longo prazo e expansão de negócios;  • Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios por meio de mapeamento de mercado, levantamento de demandas, análise do potencial das contas e prospecção estruturada;  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a laboratórios clínicos, compreendendo suas rotinas, necessidades operacionais e desafios, para propor soluções aderentes ao portfólio da empresa;  • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições de mercado, gerando inteligência comercial para apoiar o posicionamento dos produtos e a tomada de decisão;  • Aumentar market share nas contas existentes, promovendo expansão de portfólio, fidelização de clientes e desenvolvimento de novas frentes comerciais;  • Elaborar e conduzir planos de ação por conta e por território, com foco em metas, rentabilidade, potencial de crescimento e cobertura de mercado;  • Construir relacionamento com decisores e influenciadores das contas, incluindo áreas técnicas, administrativas, suprimentos e liderança dos laboratórios;  • Conduzir negociações comerciais, acompanhando propostas, condições comerciais, prazos, follow-ups e fechamento de oportunidades;  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vendas de ponta a ponta, desde a prospecção e qualificação até implantação, pós-venda e monitoramento de resultados;  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas internas como marketing, produto, aplicação, suporte e operações, assegurando alinhamento entre estratégia comercial e entrega ao cliente;  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da carteira, pipeline, conversão, participação de mercado e evolução das contas;  • Cumprir agenda de visitas, rotas e demandas comerciais dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, com atuação externa frequente na região designada.    Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;  • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;  • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;  • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;  • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;  • Domínio do Pacote Office;  • CNH categoria B;  • Disponibilidade para viagens;  • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;    Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;  • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;  • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;  • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

O Supervisor Comercial será uma peça-chave na transformação e estruturação da nossa área de vendas. Buscamos um profissional com perfil "mão na massa", que não apenas gerencie, mas também construa processos, desenvolva a equipe e execute a estratégia comercial em campo. Recrutar, contratar e treinar novos representantes para expansão de territórios. Implementar e garantir a execução de rotinas de vendas diárias e semanais (planejamento de rotas, prospecção, positivação, follow-up). Realizar rotas em campo com a equipe para suporte, treinamento, avaliação da execução no ponto de venda e atendimento a clientes estratégicos.   Estratégia e Planejamento Comercial:   Colaborar com a Diretoria na definição de metas de faturamento, volume, positivação e mix de produtos. Analisar dados de vendas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento, rentabilização e otimização de esforços. Desenvolver e implementar políticas comerciais, incluindo estratégias de precificação, descontos e comissionamento, com base em pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência. Planejar a expansão para novos mercados e canais de venda.   Execução e Trade Marketing:   Garantir excelência na execução no ponto de venda. Desenvolver ações de trade marketing para aumentar a visibilidade, o giro dos produtos e fortalecer a marca nos canais de venda. Gerenciar o relacionamento com distribuidores, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e desempenho.   Processos e Análise de Dados:   Ser o guardião dos KPIs, analisando resultados e reportando à diretoria para tomadas de decisão rápidas e precisas. Participar da transição de gestão manual de pedidos para um sistema automatizado e integrado, colaborando com a equipe interna. Fornecer insights do campo e da equipe de vendas para o planejamento de S&OP, conectando demandas comerciais à capacidade produtiva e logística.    Qualificações e Perfil do Candidato:    Experiência Essencial:   Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes de vendas externas (representantes comerciais, vendedores), preferencialmente no setor de bens de consumo, higiene e limpeza, ou em distribuidores. Vivência prática em campo, realizando rotas e negociações B2B. Habilidade com dados e indicadores (KPIs). Experiência na definição e implementação de políticas comerciais e ações de trade marketing. Histórico de sucesso em expansão de mercado e contratação de representantes. Conhecimento do mercado de limpeza será um diferencial.   Habilidades Comportamentais:   Liderança resiliente e inspiradora, capaz de gerenciar perfis diversos pelo exemplo, respeito e foco em objetivos comuns. Inteligência emocional e habilidades de negociação para construir relacionamentos sólidos, mediar conflitos e negociar eficazmente. Perfil "construtor" e "mão na massa": proativo, confortável em ambientes com poucos processos, enxergando oportunidades de criá-los e implementá-los com a equipe. Visão de dono: age com autonomia, responsabilidade e senso de urgência na resolução de problemas e captura de oportunidades. Disciplina e organização essenciais para rotinas eficazes em ambientes dinâmicos.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Coordenador de Armazém - Page Interim
description:
Empresa está contratando Coordenador de Armazém - Page Interim em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Experiência prévia com gestão de armazém para volumes secos.   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    Sobre nosso cliente   Empresa nacional do setor de embalagens busca, através de Page Interim, Coordenador de Depósito para liderar a gestão de armazéns de embalagens e caixas metálicas, em que será responsável pela programação de expedições e coletas, gestão de volumes, tratativa de desvios de qualidade e reporte de indicadores de desempenho para a matriz global.   Descrição   Liderar e gerenciar todas as operações do depósito/armazém, garantindo que as metas de produção sejam atingidas de forma regular, segura e eficiente.   Garantir a execução precisa e pontual de todas as transações do sistema (SAP, GEMS, RFID/digitalização), incluindo o fechamento do mês e as atualizações de estoque.   Gerenciar os níveis de estoque para garantir um tempo de resposta rápido, reduzindo o estoque ocioso e mantendo o trabalho em andamento (WIP) dentro das metas definidas (por exemplo, não mais do que 7 dias).   Monitorar, analisar e reduzir danos e rejeições por parte de destinatários e embaladores, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas para resolver as causas-raiz.   Supervisionar os fluxos de entrada e saída para garantir um tráfego fluido, carga/descarga eficiente e uso otimizado da capacidade do depósito.   Gerenciar e melhorar continuamente os processos de controle de qualidade e inspeção para manter os padrões de qualidade e reduzir reclamações de clientes.   Preparar e conduzir CARs eficazes para reclamações de clientes e não conformidades internas, garantindo um acompanhamento robusto e o encerramento dos casos.   Estabelecer, manter e fazer cumprir os SOPs, fluxos de processo e padrões de inspeção no depósito, alinhados com os procedimentos globais.   Exercer uma liderança firme e assertiva junto às equipes dos depósitos e prestadores de serviços, responsabilizando-os pelo desempenho, conformidade e segurança.   Conduzir negociações e avaliações de desempenho com os prestadores de serviços de depósito e logística, garantindo melhores níveis de serviço, eficiência de custos e confiabilidade.   Identificar e resolver questões operacionais complexas, utilizando análise de dados e colaboração multifuncional para implementar soluções sustentáveis e criativas.   Impulsionar o controle, a redução e a contenção de custos nas operações do depósito, aplicando uma visão de custo total de propriedade a todas as despesas.   Oferecer um alto padrão de atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas, garantindo uma comunicação clara, proativa e orientada para soluções.   Gerenciar a comunicação operacional diária (por exemplo, e-mails, relatórios, painéis) para manter as partes interessadas informadas sobre desempenho, riscos e planos de ação.   Apoiar o Gerente de Cadeia de Suprimentos e a equipe local conforme necessário, atuando como ponto de contato principal para assuntos e iniciativas relacionados ao depósito.    Perfil desejável   Graduação em qualquer área de Engenharia, Logística, Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão de Armazéns ou áreas correlatas;   Experiência em gestão de armazéns;   Conhecimentos de informática - Microsoft Office, Outlook, etc;   Conhecimento em SAP;   Conhecimento em ISO 45001 e WMS;   Experiência com Lean / Six Sigma será diferencial;   Conhecimento avançado em inglês.    O que está sendo ofertado   Faixa salarial de R$8.000,00 a R$10.000,00;   Contrato terceiro (CLT) através de Page Interim;   Modelo de Trabalho: modelo híbrido 3x2 (Campinas/SP).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Assistant em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.  DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.  About The Job  The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.  Working Tasks and Responsibilities  Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.  What You’ll Bring  Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.  Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together!  We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at  .

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:  The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad. Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators. One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data. OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable. REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable). Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:  Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel); experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Requisitos:  • Graduação completa; • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos; • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios; • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial; • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas; • Domínio do Pacote Office; • CNH categoria B; • Disponibilidade para viagens; • Residir em Campinas ou arredores; Diferenciais  • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos; • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais; • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado; • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

description:

Hey, Dingus!   Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.   About Us   Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.   Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.   What You'll Do   Build and maintain automated workflows using N8 N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines. Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments. Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines. Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production. Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head. Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately. Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask. Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time. Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists. What You Bring   2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8 N, , or Zapier, N8 N strongly preferred). Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs. Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures. Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations. Basic scripting ability in Python or Java Script, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding. A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs. A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it. Bonus Points   Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.). Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (Lang Chain, or equivalent concepts). Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment. Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design. Work Details   Hours: 9 A. M. – 5 P. M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.   Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!   Note: Due to the high number of applicants across roles, responses and processes will take a while.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior java developer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.   Propósito do Cargo   Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.   Responsabilidades Principais:   Desenvolvimento Backend   Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura   Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações   Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy   Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA   Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento   Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios:   Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis:   Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos:   Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura:   Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix   Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.   Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.   Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Airbus a320 pic captain - abu dhabi relocation
description:

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

title: Captain - airbus a320 - etihad
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Captain - airbus a320 - etihad em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Job Description  Make the world your home.    It's an extraordinary time to join Etihad. In 2025 alone we've carried over 10 million guests, announced 30+ new destinations, and recorded the strongest half-year profit in our history. With more than 20 new aircraft arriving this year and a clear path to double our fleet by 2030, we're investing heavily in the future and redefining what global aviation looks like.    Just as we push boundaries for our guests through innovation, sustainability, and world-class service, we're equally committed to providing our pilots with exceptional careers. Etihad, ranked the world's safest airline, offers a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle for you and your family, complemented by tax-free salaries, concessionary travel, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for progression inside and beyond the cockpit.    What we offer    Etihad provides a competitive, tax-free package designed to reward performance and support your lifestyle in Abu Dhabi. Your annual package includes basic salary, flying pay, housing allowance, and layover and meal allowances, with the potential to earn up to AED 674,029 (USD 181,589) per year based on 75 flying hours per month. Your salary includes performance-based annual increments, complemented by a comprehensive range of benefits: Education allowance of up to AED 40,000 for primary and AED 55,000 for secondary per child, for up to three children Income protection scheme 42 days of annual leave Industry-leading staff travel benefits and access to Etihad's exclusive discounts End-of-service benefits Accidental and life insurance coverage Etihad supports candidates relocating to Abu Dhabi through initiatives such as a shipping container allowance, settling-in support, and family travel benefits from any location in the world The Role  As a Captain with Etihad, you hold ultimate authority for the safe, secure, and efficient operation of every flight. You are entrusted with technical command of the aircraft, leadership of the crew, and the responsibility to uphold Etihad's highest standards of professionalism.   Ensure the safety and security of crew, passengers, cargo, and aircraft at all times Exercise full command of the aircraft from taxi-out to final engine shutdown Lead the flight and cabin crew, demonstrating strong decision-making and effective crew resource management Operate with efficiency and environmental responsibility, in line with company fuel and sustainability policies Deliver consistent On Time Performance to meet Etihad's commitment to reliability and guest satisfaction What you'll bring  To be considered for the role of Captain A320, you must meet the criteria below:   A minimum of 5500 hours total flying time. A minimum of 2500 PIC hours on multi crew, glass cockpit (1) A minimum of 1500 PIC hours on one of the A320 Family Flown A320 family within the last 12 months Type rating on A320 should be valid for a minimum of 2 months at the time of joining Unrestricted and current ICAO ATPL Current on A320 Unrestricted and current Class 1 medical Have not attained the age of 59 years on the day of joining Current TRE/TRI is an advantage English Language Fluency (written and verbal) Level 4 or higher In case of hours accumulated on flights with inflight relief, 75% of the total hours shall be counted towards the required minimum (1) Glass Cockpit: aircraft with a FMS coupled to APFDS  Additional Information    Etihad Airways is more than the UAE's national airline - we're shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, our pilots fly one of the world's most modern and efficient fleets, operating across six continents and connecting people and cultures every day. As we advance our " Journey 2030" ambition to double our fleet and expand our global network, we're creating unparalleled opportunities for pilots to grow, lead and fly at the highest level. Join us and take your career to new horizons with an airline built for the future.    To learn more visit    Recruitment Fraud Alert Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.      Are you located in Argentina? Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our Dev Ops challenges.      Are you well-versed in system security principles?    A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.      Are you available to work on call when needed?    Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times. Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences. Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life.    Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays. Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best.    Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

Requisitos:   • Graduação completa;   • Vivência no segmento de diagnóstico clínico IVD, preferencialmente com relacionamento junto a laboratórios clínicos;   • Experiência em gestão de contas, prospecção e desenvolvimento de negócios;   • Conhecimento em análise de mercado, concorrência e planejamento comercial;   • Habilidade para negociação, relacionamento com clientes e condução de vendas consultivas;   • Domínio do Pacote Office;   • CNH categoria B;   • Disponibilidade para viagens;   • Residir em Campinas ou arredores;      Diferenciais   • Experiência prévia com carteira de laboratórios clínicos;   • Conhecimento do mercado de diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e suas dinâmicas comerciais;   • Vivência com contas estratégicas e expansão regional de mercado;   • Familiaridade com CRM, gestão de funil e indicadores comerciais.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.   This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.   What you'll do   Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results. What we're looking for   We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.   You'll be successful in this role if you have:   Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow). Nice to have (not required)   Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval. Why Join Us   You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.   Equal Opportunity   Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. title: Cloud windows infrastructure engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Cloud windows infrastructure engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer   Job Purpose   As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Power Shell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.   AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.   The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.   This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.   Role Responsibilities   Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain Power Shell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, Cloud Watch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation. Essential Skills & Experience   Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)   7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSo P, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced Power Shell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: Perf Mon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics. Identity & Authentication   Hybrid identity: AD on-prem cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments. AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)   Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector. Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.   Service Operations & Remote Working   Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague. Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement   This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:   Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage. On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Médico endocrinologista (rqe)
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"   Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!   A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.   *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*   A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.   *O QUE PROCURAMOS:*   Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;   DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:   Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. REQUISITOS   Formação Acadêmica:   Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA. Certificações:   Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil). Experiência:   Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;   Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:   Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..   Competências Comportamentais:   Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.   Outros Requisitos Importantes:   Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.   Local de Trabalho:   REMOTO   IMPORTANTE:   MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.   REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.   Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Virtual marketing assistant
